follow-up time: Children were born during 1993-1996 and their weight and height were measured in 2000
exposure: non-medically indicated maternal request caesarean delivery
cohort: 181,380 children born in China between 1993 and 1996 to mothers registered in a perinatal care surveillance system
finding: Caesarean delivery, including non-medically indicated maternal request caesarean delivery, was associated with a modestly increased risk of childhood overweight compared with vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Children born by caesarean delivery on maternal request were also more likely to be overweight.
